package_declarations.name: BfgsVerification.LGlobalFailure.nonstrict_actual_global_failure
package_declarations.signature:
∀ {μ c₁ c₂ : ℝ},
  0 < μ →
    0 < c₁ →
      c₁ ≤ 1 / 3 →
        c₁ < c₂ →
          c₂ < 1 →
            ∀ U ∈ nhds 0,
              ∃ R,
                R.c₁ = c₁ ∧
                  R.c₂ = c₂ ∧
                    Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                      Filter.Tendsto R.H Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun k => BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ (R.x k)) Filter.atTop
                            (nhds 0) ∧
                          (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ (R.x k)) ∧
                            (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ (R.x (k + 1)) <
                                  BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ (R.x k)) ∧
                              (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                  R.α k = BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.length (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.phase k)) ∧
                                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                    BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.fromMetric
                                        (BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (R.x k) (R.H k) c₁ c₂ 5 =
                                      (Option.some (R.α k),
                                        BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialHistory (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.phase k))) ∧
                                  (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                      BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.fromMetric
                                          (BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) (R.x k) (R.H k) c₁ c₂ 5 =
                                        (Option.some (R.α k),
                                          BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialHistory
                                            (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.phase k))) ∧
                                    (∀ (k : ℕ), R.x k ∈ U) ∧
                                      (∀ (k : ℕ) (q : Fin 9),
                                          BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase q = BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.phase k →
                                            DifferentiableAt ℝ (BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ)
                                                (R.x k +
                                                  BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialLength q •
                                                    BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) 1) ∧
                                              0 <
                                                  BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ
                                                    (R.x k +
                                                      BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialLength q •
                                                        BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) 1) ∧
                                                R.x k +
                                                    BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialLength q •
                                                      BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) 1 ∈
                                                  U) ∧
                                        (∀ (q : ℕ → Fin 9),
                                            (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                                BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase (q k) =
                                                  BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.phase k) →
                                              Filter.Tendsto
                                                (fun k =>
                                                  R.x k +
                                                    BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialLength (q k) •
                                                      BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) 1)
                                                Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
                                          (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                              BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ (R.x (k + 1)) <
                                                  BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ (R.x k) +
                                                    c₁ *
                                                      BfgsVerification.dot (R.g k)
                                                        (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) (R.α k)) ∧
                                                c₂ *
                                                    BfgsVerification.dot (R.g k)
                                                      (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) (R.α k)) <
                                                  BfgsVerification.dot (R.g (k + 1))
                                                    (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (R.H k) (R.g k) (R.α k))) ∧
                                            0 ∉
                                              BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential
                                                (BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ) 0

package_declarations.name: BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun.homogeneous_conclusion_of_bounded_zero_sublevel
package_declarations.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F),
  BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne F →
    Bornology.IsBounded {x | F x ≤ 0} →
      F 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), x ≠ 0 → 0 < F x) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

package_declarations.name: BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun.norm_conclusion
package_declarations.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} (N : Seminorm ℝ (BfgsVerification.Vec n)),
  (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), N x = 0 → x = 0) →
    ∀ (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n ⇑N),
      N 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), x ≠ 0 → 0 < N x) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => N (R.x k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

package_declarations.name: BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun.finiteMaxLinear_conclusion
package_declarations.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} (A : Finset (BfgsVerification.Vec n)) (hA : A.Nonempty),
